title: Singapore Wild Trails and Island Days
alt: Macaw in flight at Bird Paradise in the Mandai wildlife reserve, Singapore
transport: Private airport transfers with shared coaches for tours and tickets

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Six days lets you take the parks slowly. One wildlife day, one city day, one island day, one theme park day and nothing rushed.
expert.tip: The hotel sits on Orchard Road, so the last evening is best spent walking the length of it rather than booking anything.

summary: Six days through the green and the glass. Bird Paradise and the Night Safari at Mandai, the city tour with the SkyPark and Floral Fantasy, Sentosa with the cable car, oceanarium and Wings of Time, then a full day at Universal Studios.
included: Included: 5 nights at the Hotel Grand Central with daily breakfast; Bird Paradise; Night Safari with tram ride; half day city tour; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark; Gardens by the Bay with Floral Fantasy; two way cable car sky pass; Singapore Oceanarium; Wings of Time; Universal Studios one day pass; 11 private and shared transfers; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; attractions not named above; personal expenses.

day_titles.3: City tour, SkyPark and Floral Fantasy
day_titles.4: Sentosa, oceanarium and Wings of Time

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to Orchard Road
Time at Jewel before you leave the airport if the flight lands early
Check in at the Hotel Grand Central and keep the evening free
Optional: supper at a hawker centre or the Orchard Road food halls
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer out to the Mandai reserve
Bird Paradise with eight walk through aviaries and the Penguin Cove
Long lunch at the reserve, then rest before the evening
Night Safari with a tram ride and the nocturnal walking trails
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, Marina Bay, Chinatown and the civic district
Marina Bay Sands SkyPark on level 57 above the bay
Floral Fantasy and the Supertree grove at Gardens by the Bay
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Mount Faber for the cable car
Two way sky pass over the harbour to Sentosa
Singapore Oceanarium with its open ocean tank and reef galleries
Wings of Time on Siloso beach once it is dark
5: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Resorts World Sentosa
One day pass for Universal Studios across all seven zones
Shows, coasters and the themed streets at your own pace
Return shared transfer in the evening
6: Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

stops.name: Singapore
stops.accom: 5 nights · Breakfast included · Standard room · 4★ · Hotel Grand Central on Orchard Road, beside Somerset MRT and the malls

program.name: Parks, skyline and one theme park
program.description: Five nights on Orchard Road with a full wildlife day at Mandai, a city day at Marina Bay and two island days on Sentosa.

activities.name: Bird Paradise
activities.description: Eight walk through aviaries at Mandai, from African wetlands to the Amazon, with keeper talks through the day.

activities.name: Night Safari with Tram Ride
activities.description: A tram circuit through the Mandai park after dark, then walking trails past the smaller nocturnal animals.

activities.name: Half Day Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour of Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the colonial quarter.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
activities.description: The level 57 observation deck above the bay, the Gardens and the financial district towers.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: Floral Fantasy with its hanging gardens and the Supertree grove, best as the lights come on.

activities.name: Singapore Cable Car Sky Pass
activities.description: A two way ride between Mount Faber, HarbourFront and Sentosa, high above the working harbour.

activities.name: Singapore Oceanarium
activities.description: Sentosa's rebuilt aquarium with an open ocean tank, reef habitats and a research wing.

activities.name: Wings of Time
activities.description: A twenty minute night show on Siloso beach built from water screens, lasers and fire.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A one day pass covering Sci Fi City, Ancient Egypt, Far Far Away and the Hollywood boulevard.
